ArcControlSpec.description:
The displacement an arc is measured on (1.3): one
node's translation, instead of the norm of the whole state. Displacement
control with the load factor as the unknown -- OpenSees' DisplacementControl
integrator -- so the pushed point moves on at every increment and the
path cannot turn back down an unloading branch; it cannot follow a
snap-back of that displacement.

a region of ONE node

ArcLengthSpec.description:
Crisfield's cylindrical arc length: the load factor
becomes an unknown, so the path can pass a limit point -- a pushover's
peak, a snap-through, a snap-back.

initial.description:
第一个增量的荷载因子（据此定弧长）

the first increment's load factor (which sets the arc length)

max_increments.title: Max Increments

每步增量数上限

increments per step, at most

每个增量期望的迭代次数：弧长按 sqrt(期望/实际) 伸缩

where to stop when the load factor does not reach 1

用弧长法的分析步名；不给则所有步都用（其余步用荷载控制的 Newton）

the steps that use it, by name; all of them when left out (the others take load-controlled Newton)

弧长只量这一个位移（1.3）：位移控制，荷载因子是未知量；被控位移不会往回走，跟不了它自己的回跳；不给则量整个状态

measure the arc on this one displacement (1.3): displacement control with the load factor unknown; the controlled displacement never goes back, and cannot follow its own snap-back; the whole state's norm when left out

the rise: how far the curve is from the chord at its middle, along `up` (negative: below)

shape.title: Shape

`parabola`（按弦等分，桥梁拱轴的常用形状）或 `circle`（按圆心角等分）

`parabola` (nodes evenly along the chord, the usual arch axis) or `circle` (evenly by angle)

矢高的方向（与弦不能平行；默认整体 +z）

the direction of the rise (not along the chord; default global +z)

stop when it reaches this displacement (signed)

section.title: Section
section.description:
`sections` 里的名字

a name in `sections`

region.title: Region
region.description:
目标二选一：网格区域，或一个/多个钢筋组

exactly one target: a mesh region, or one or more reinforcement sets

reinforcement.title: Reinforcement
reinforcement.description:
`reinforcement` 里的一个或多个名字：这个（杆）截面描述的钢筋

one or more names in `reinforcement`: the bars this (bar) section describes

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description:
梁/连接器：确定截面局部 y 轴的向量（不能与构件平行）

beam/connector: a vector fixing the section's local y axis (not parallel to the member)

releases.title: Releases
releases.description:
梁端释放，取自 i_rx, i_ry, i_rz, j_rx, j_ry, j_rz（i 为第一个节点）；两端铰接写 [i_ry, i_rz, j_ry, j_rz]

beam end releases, from i_rx, i_ry, i_rz, j_rx, j_ry, j_rz (i = first node); a pin at both ends is [i_ry, i_rz, j_ry, j_rz]

end_offsets.title: End Offsets
end_offsets.description:
梁端刚性偏移（1.21）：{i: [x, y, z], j: [x, y, z], axes: local|global, per: line|member, axial: elastic|full}，弹性段两端离节点的向量（`local` 是构件按节点连线和 `orientation` 定的轴）。梁端刚域沿构件给，截面偏心（形心在节点下方）横向给。`axial: full` 让框架梁的轴向和扭转刚度按节点间的长度算；默认 `elastic` 按弹性段

rigid end offsets (1.21): {i: [x, y, z], j: [x, y, z], axes: local|global, per: line|member, axial: elastic|full}, the vectors from the nodes to the ends of the member's elastic part (`local`: the member's axes from its nodes' chord and `orientation`). A rigid end zone is an offset along the member, a section whose centroid is below its nodes one across it. `axial: full` takes a frame beam's axial and torsional stiffness over the length between the nodes; `elastic`, the default, over the elastic part

coordinate_system.title: Coordinate System
coordinate_system.description:
连接器：`local`（x 沿弦、y 由 `orientation` 定）或 `global` 分量

connector: `local` (x along the chord, y from `orientation`) or `global` components

bond.title: Bond
bond.description:
嵌入钢筋：`{type: bond_ceb | bond_cyclic, ...}` 让钢筋有自己的自由度并按粘结–滑移律传力；不给即完全粘结

embedded bars: `{type: bond_ceb | bond_cyclic, ...}` gives the bar its own dofs and a bond-slip law; absent = perfect bond

segment_length.title: Segment Length
segment_length.description:
嵌入钢筋：几何没给时，这组每根线的分段长度（m）

embedded bars: segment length (m) for every line of the set, when the geometry gives none

divisions.title: Divisions
divisions.description:
嵌入钢筋：几何没给时，每根线的分段数

embedded bars: segments per line, when the geometry gives none

transverse_penalty.title: Transverse Penalty
transverse_penalty.description:
粘结钢筋：横向约束刚度（N/m），默认取钢筋自身 EA/L_trib。数值罚函数，不是销栓作用

bonded bars: stiffness holding the bar across its axis (N/m); default the bar's own E A / L_trib. A numerical device, not a dowel

host_deduction.title: Host Deduction
host_deduction.description:
从钢筋应力里扣除混凝土基体的 E·ε（只对弹性基体；基体会损伤时求解器拒绝）

subtract the host's E*eps from the bar (elastic hosts only; the solver refuses it with a damaging host -- see elements/truss.py)

anchorage.title: Anchorage
anchorage.description:
纤维梁：应变渗透 {region, bar_diameter}；粘结钢筋：`ends`/`start`/`end` 把钢筋端节点绑到基体上

fiber beams: strain penetration, {region, bar_diameter}; bonded bars: `ends` / `start` / `end`, the bar nodes tied to the host

prestress.title: Prestress
prestress.description:
先张：扣除损失后的**有效**预应力（Pa，受拉为正）。程序只算弹性压缩损失——写 σ_pe，不是 σ_con

pretensioning: the EFFECTIVE prestress in the bar after losses, Pa, positive in tension. The program computes the elastic-shortening loss (it is what equilibrium at transfer gives) and nothing else -- write sigma_pe here, not sigma_con.

friction.title: Friction
friction.description:
后张摩擦 {mu, k, jack, anchor_set}：给了则 `prestress` 是张拉端应力，程序沿束算损失剖面；不给则整根束都是 `prestress`

post-tensioning friction {mu, k, jack, anchor_set}. With it, `prestress` is the JACKING stress and the solver computes the profile along the tendon; without it, `prestress` is what the whole tendon carries.

unstressed_length.title: Unstressed Length
unstressed_length.description:
线区域上的 `bar` 截面作为索：总无应力长度（代替 `prestress`）

a `bar` section on a line region as a CABLE: its total unstressed length (an alternative to `prestress`), and whether it carries no compression

unstressed_lengths.title: Unstressed Lengths
unstressed_lengths.description:
区域内每个单元一个无应力长度，按单元顺序（找形的输出）

one per element of the region, in element order (form-finding output)

jack.title: Jack
jack.description:
索按力张拉（N）：在建立它的那个分析步（从头就建的是第一步）结束时，每根构件的轴力正好是这个值，不管结构在张拉中让了多少；此后它是一根普通的杆，无应力长度就是那一步结束时定下的。只用于框架模型（梁、杆、连接器）

the force (N) a cable is JACKED to: at the end of the analysis step that builds it (the first, when built from the start) each member carries exactly this, whatever the structure gave under it; from then on it is a bar of the unstressed length it ended with. Frame models (beams, bars, connectors) only

tension_only.title: Tension Only
tension_only.description:
索：不受压（松弛后力为零）

cable: the member carries no compression (goes slack)

failure.title: Failure
failure.description:
线构件的弹脆性断裂：见 schema.FailureSpec

elastic-brittle breaking of a line member: see schema.FailureSpec

name.title: Name
name.description:
钢筋组的名字，供监测量（`of:`）和结果字段用；默认取截面名

the reinforcement set's name for monitors (`of:`) and result fields; defaults to the section name

ConnectorLawSpec.description:
A path-dependent law on ONE component of a connector:
`gap` (free travel, then a stop), `bilinear` (elastic-plastic with
kinematic hardening: an isolator, a yielding device) or `friction`
(Coulomb: sticks, then slides at mu times the compression another
component of the same connector carries). elements/connector.py has the
mechanics; one scalar of history per component, the slipped deformation.

type.title: Type
type.description:
律的种类：`gap` 间隙/限位，`bilinear` 双线性滞回（隔震支座、屈服耗能装置），`friction` 库仑摩擦滑动，`damper` 非线性粘滞阻尼器 F = c·sign(v)·|v|^α（1.10），`pendulum` 摩擦摆支座（1.10），`material` 材料表里的一维材料，F = area·σ(d/length)（1.21）

`gap`, `bilinear`, `friction`, `damper` (a fluid viscous damper, F = c sign(v) |v|^alpha; 1.10), `pendulum` (a friction pendulum bearing; 1.10) or `material` (a one-dimensional law of the material table, F = area sigma(d / length); 1.21)

lo.title: Lo
lo.description:
gap：自由行程的下限（m 或 rad），不给即该侧无限位（friction 的粘着刚度是 `stiffness`，不读 `lo`）

gap: lower bound of the free travel (None = no stop that side); friction does not read it (its stick stiffness is `stiffness`)

hi.title: Hi
hi.description:
gap：自由行程的上限；在局部 ux（伸长为正）上，`{lo: 0}` 是只受压的支承（压紧受力、拉开自由），`{hi: 0}` 是只受拉的

gap: upper bound of the free travel; on the local ux (elongation positive) `{lo: 0}` is a compression-only seat and `{hi: 0}` a tension-only tie

stiffness.title: Stiffness
stiffness.description:
gap：碰到限位后的刚度（N/m 或 N·m/rad）；friction、pendulum：粘着刚度；damper：与阻尼器并联的弹簧（可不写）

gap: the stop's stiffness once a bound is reached; friction, pendulum: the stick stiffness before sliding; damper: a spring beside the damper (optional)

k1.title: K1
k1.description:
bilinear：初始刚度

bilinear: initial (elastic) stiffness

k2.title: K2
k2.description:
bilinear：屈服后刚度（0 = 理想塑性；须小于 k1）

bilinear: post-yield stiffness (0 = perfectly plastic; must be below k1)

fy.title: Fy
fy.description:
bilinear：屈服力（N 或 N·m）

bilinear: yield force

mu.title: Mu
mu.description:
friction、pendulum：摩擦系数

friction, pendulum: coefficient of friction

radius.title: Radius
radius.description:
pendulum：滑动球面的等效曲率半径（m）；恢复刚度是 N/radius，N 为支座当时的压力

pendulum: effective radius of the sliding surface; the restoring stiffness is N / radius, N the compression the bearing carries at that instant

c.title: C
c.description:
damper：阻尼系数 c（N·(s/m)^α），F = c·sign(v)·|v|^α

damper: the coefficient c of F = c sign(v) |v|^alpha (force per velocity^alpha)

exponent.title: Exponent
exponent.description:
damper：速度指数 α，0 < α ≤ 1（1 即线性阻尼器；桥梁常用 0.2–0.5）

damper: the velocity exponent alpha, 0 < alpha <= 1 (1 is the linear dashpot; bridges use 0.2-0.5)

linear_below.title: Linear Below
linear_below.description:
damper：低于这个速度（m/s）时按线性 F = c·v0^(α-1)·v；α < 1 时必须写（v → 0 时幂律的斜率无穷大，显式积分会在零速附近抖动）。取设计速度的 1% 左右

damper: below this velocity the law is linear, F = c v0^(alpha-1) v; required when alpha < 1 (the power law's slope is infinite at v = 0 and an explicit step chatters there). About 1% of the design velocity

normal.title: Normal
normal.description:
friction：压紧力从哪来——`ux`（同一连接器局部 ux 线性弹簧当前的压力；只有它的正负与节点顺序无关），或一个常数（N）

friction: where the compression comes from -- `ux` (the current compression of this connector's local ux spring, the one component whose sign does not depend on the node order) or a constant force

material.title: Material
material.description:
material：`materials` 里一维材料的名字（可以是 parallel、series、gap）

material: the name of a one-dimensional law in `materials` (parallel, series and gap included)

area.title: Area
area.description:
material：力 = area × 应力；不写为 1（材料表即力–变形关系）

material: force = area x stress; 1 when left out (the table is then the force-deformation relation)

length.title: Length
length.description:
material：应变 = 变形 / length；不写为 1

material: strain = deformation / length; 1 when left out

ConnectorLawSpec.title: ConnectorLawSpec

region.title: Region
region.description:
约束作用的节点

the nodes the constraint applies to

dofs.title: Dofs
dofs.description:
1 = 约束/强制，0 = 自由，顺序 [ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz]；只有平动的模型给三个

1 = held/prescribed, 0 = free, in the order [ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz]; three entries on a translation-only model

value.title: Value
value.description:
强制位移；标量或三分量向量。不给 = 固定为零

prescribed displacement; scalar or 3-vector. None = held at zero.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description:
强制的运动量 `value × amplitude(progress)`：位移、速度或加速度；后两者只用于动力分析

Kinematic quantity prescribed by `value * amplitude(progress)`. Velocity and acceleration are dynamic-analysis conditions.

keep.title: Keep
keep.description:
只用于步内约束（1.2）：以后各步继续保持（解除见步的 `release`）；不写则只在本步有效

a step's constraint only (1.2): it holds in every later step, until a step's `release` frees its nodes; without it a step's constraint is that step's alone

amplitude.title: Amplitude
amplitude.description:
幅值曲线名；默认：分级松弛的步里 `ramp`（一步内 0 到 1），连续松弛与动力分析里 `ramp_hold`（前段升到 1 后保持），后续步里的模型级荷载和带 `to_age` 的时间步里的一切 `hold`

name of an amplitude curve; by default `ramp` (0 to 1 over the step) in a staged relaxation, `ramp_hold` (up to 1, then held) in a continuous relaxation or a dynamic run, and `hold` for a model-level load in a later step and for everything in a time step (`to_age`)

record.description:
支承自己的地面运动记录（多点激励）：被标记的平动自由度按记录随时间运动

the support's own ground-motion record (multiple-support excitation): the flagged translational dofs follow it in time

ContactBodySpec.description:
A set of line members that take part in the contact between members,
and the radius of the capsule each of them is (1.11).

region.title: Region
region.description:
参与接触的构件所在的区域（两端节点都在区域内的构件；连接器不参与）

the region whose members take part (a member is in when both its points are; connectors take no part)

radius.title: Radius
radius.description:
胶囊体半径（m）：构件表面到轴线的距离。`auto` 只用于杆和索（取与截面等面积的圆）；梁必须写

the capsule's radius, the distance of the member's surface from its axis. `auto` is for bars and cables alone (the circle of their area); a beam must say

ContactBodySpec.title: ContactBodySpec

rigid.title: Rigid
rigid.description:
刚性面列表（地面、海底、承台顶面……）

the rigid surfaces (ground, sea floor, a pile cap ...)

members.description:
线单元构件之间的接触（1.11）：落梁、梁体碰撞、倒塌堆积

contact between line members (1.11): a falling span, pounding girders, the pile a collapse leaves

type.title: Type
type.description:
阻尼类型：viscous、kinetic、rayleigh、none。不给时按模式定——松弛 kinetic，动力 none（动力分析不要用 kinetic，它会抹掉动力响应）

NO DEFAULT HERE, DELIBERATELY, AND IT IS THE ONE FIELD THAT NEEDS NONE. The right default depends on the analysis mode -- kinetic for relaxation, undamped for dynamic -- which this file cannot see. It used to default to "kinetic", and because a pydantic model always emits its fields, that made the mode-dependent expression in SIX solvers dead code: every `mode: dynamic` run got kinetic damping, which zeroes the velocity at every kinetic-energy peak and so removes the dynamics it is applied to.  `None` here, resolved in the solver with `or` -- never with a `get` default, which a present-but-None key walks straight past. See `solver_setting` above for the general rule.

coeff.title: Coeff
coeff.description:
viscous：单位质量的阻尼系数（1/s）

viscous: damping ratio-like coefficient per unit mass (1/s)

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description:
质量比例阻尼（1/s）。用于 `type: rayleigh`，以及松弛里与 `kinetic` 叠加（0.1 版为软化问题设计的组合）；`viscous`、`none` 下写了会被拒绝。软化问题上它会选择解的分支

Mass-proportional damping, 1/s. Applied under `type: rayleigh`, and ALONGSIDE `type: kinetic` in a relaxation -- refused under `viscous` and `none`, where the frame solvers ignored it. `type: kinetic` with a small alpha is the combination it exists for: kinetic damping only fires when the kinetic energy peaks, so a mode whose energy grows monotonically -- a softening element -- is never touched by it, while alpha*M*v opposes velocity whatever the energy is doing. It is not free: on a softening problem it selects a solution branch (v0.1 has the measurements).

beta.title: Beta
beta.description:
刚度比例阻尼（s）；只用于动力分析的 `type: rayleigh`，会缩小稳定步长

stiffness-proportional damping, s; `type: rayleigh` in a dynamic analysis only; makes the stable step smaller

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description:
Rayleigh 的另一种写法：在 `frequencies` 的两个频率上各给阻尼比——一个数（两处相同）或 [ζ1, ζ2]；alpha、beta 由此算出

Rayleigh stated by its damping ratio at the two `frequencies` (one number, or [zeta_1, zeta_2]); alpha and beta are computed from it

frequencies.title: Frequencies
frequencies.description:
给 `ratio` 的两个频率（Hz）：通常取第一阶和参与显著的最高阶

the two frequencies (Hz) `ratio` is stated at: usually the first mode and the highest one that matters

regions.title: Regions
regions.description:
分区 Rayleigh 阻尼（1.22）：[{regions: [区域名], alpha/beta 或 ratio(/frequencies)}]。列出的区域里的构件（连同它们的刚域质量）用这一项的系数，其余构件和集中质量用上面的；两项重叠时后写的算；不写 frequencies 时用上面那两个频率。只用于动力分析的 `type: rayleigh`，线模型（beam2、beam2_timoshenko、beam2_fiber、mixed_line）

Rayleigh damping by region (1.22): [{regions: [names], alpha/beta or ratio(/frequencies)}]. The members of the listed regions (with their rigid zones' mass) take this entry's coefficients; the other members and the concentrated masses take the ones above; where two entries overlap the later one holds; an entry's `ratio` without `frequencies` is stated at the two above. `type: rayleigh` in a dynamic run, line models only (core/damping.py)

DiaphragmSpec.description:
A floor that is rigid in its own plane.

The nodes of `region` move together as one rigid body in the plane normal
to `normal`: two translations and the rotation about `normal`. Everything
else -- the out-of-plane translation and the two bending rotations -- stays
free, which is what makes this a diaphragm and not a rigid body.

It is how a building's floor slab is written down when the slab itself is
not meshed, and it is what an OpenSees model means by `rigidDiaphragm`.

region.title: Region
region.description:
绑在一起的节点

the nodes tied together

normal.title: Normal
normal.description:
平面法向：节点在垂直于它的平面内作刚体运动

the plane's normal: the nodes move as a rigid body within the plane normal to it

DiaphragmSpec.title: DiaphragmSpec

ErosionSpec.description:
Element deletion, after Abaqus `ELEMENT DELETION` / LS-DYNA `ERODE`.

A softening model has no answer for a fully degraded element: it still has
nodes and still carries whatever residual force they carry, but no stiffness
to resist it.  Both commercial codes answer by removing the element.

damage.title: Damage
damage.description:
损伤达到或超过它时积分点算失效（Abaqus 保留单元时 MAX DEGRADATION 为 0.99）

damage at or above which the point counts as failed (Abaqus MAX DEGRADATION is 0.99 when elements are kept, 1.0 when they are deleted; MAT_CSCM erodes at d > 0.99)

measure.title: Measure
measure.description:
读哪个损伤变量：`d`（应力用的刚度退化）、`dt` 受拉、`dc` 受压

which damage variable `damage` is read from: `d`, the stiffness degradation the stress carries (capped at the material's damage_max, so a threshold above the cap never fires); or `dt` / `dc`, the tensile and compressive variables on their own (CDP's DAMAGET / DAMAGEC, uncapped). `dc` is the spalling rule: crushed concrete goes, cracked concrete stays and keeps holding its bars -- on the Alberta beam a rule on `d` removed the cracked tension zone first.

strain.title: Strain
strain.description:
同时必须超过的最大主 Green–Lagrange 应变，取单元中心

max principal Green-Lagrange strain that must ALSO be exceeded, measured at the element centre. MAT_CSCM spells this as ERODE - 1 and FHWA's own deck uses 0.05. It is a KINEMATIC measure on purpose -- a plastic strain is rescaled by the crack band, so a threshold set for one element size would not carry to another (see continuum.strain_measures).

points.title: Points
points.description:
单元内要有多少个积分点达到 `damage`——LS-DYNA 的 NUMFIP，默认 1

how many of the element's integration points must reach `damage` -- LS-DYNA NUMFIP, whose default of 1 means one failed point out of eight deletes a fully integrated hexahedron. Defaults here to half the points, rounded up.

min_volume_ratio.title: Min Volume Ratio
min_volume_ratio.description:
无关判据的保险：体积塌缩或翻转到低于这个比例的单元无论材料怎么说都删

FiberShearSpec.description:
A cracking shear law for a fibre section, in series
with the fibres' bending: V = GA0 gamma until the section cracks, then
the cracked stiffness, then (optionally) a stirrup-yield plateau with a
small hardening; unloading and reloading run to the origin once cracked.

The cracked stiffness is given, or taken from the 45-degree truss of the
stirrups (Park & Paulay 1975, sec. 7.3): GA_cr = rho_v / (1 + 4 n rho_v)
E_s b_w d, rho_v = A_v / (b_w s), n = E_s / E_c. The section cracks in
shear when its concrete first cracks in flexure (`cracking: flexural`,
the flexure-shear cracks a frame member actually has), or at a stated
shear force.

line_load: this load is the weight of something (superimposed dead load, surfacing, parapets), so carry its mass |q|/g too, lumped to the members' end nodes in all three translations. The mass weighs nothing (the load IS its weight), so `gravity` does not count it twice; it gives the load inertia in a dynamic run, a modal analysis and a response spectrum. g is 9.80665 m/s² in the declared units. MonitorSpec.description:
One scalar time history, written to `monitors/<name>` in the result.

Four kinds, and the split is which THING the monitor reduces over:

  reaction, displacement   the NODES of a region
  element                  the ELEMENTS a region owns -- every node of the
                           element inside it, the rule a section
                           assignment already uses
  bar                      the SEGMENTS of one reinforcement set

The last two exist because a verification contract can only read monitors
and whole-model field extrema. Before them, case_15 could not assert the
tendon stress it is built around (bar stress lives in `rebar_steps/`,
which contracts cannot read) and had to stand in the camber for it, and it
could not say "the constant-moment region has not crushed" -- only "no
element anywhere has", which the anchorage zone decides. Both of those
limits are recorded in that case's contract; both are now expressible.

axle.title: Axle

What a strain gauge on the deck or the soffit reads, and what a thesis reports as 上缘/下缘.

MovingLoadSpec.description:
A group of axles travelling along the members of a region.

The region's members must form one open chain; `s` is arc length along it
from the end that comes first in (x, y, z), so a bridge laid out along +x
is entered at its left end by a positive `speed`.

`axles` are `[offset, force]` pairs: `offset` is the axle's position along
the path RELATIVE to the group's reference point (so a trailing axle 4.2 m
behind a lead axle is -4.2, whichever way the group travels), and `force`
is its magnitude along `direction`, which defaults to straight down. An
axle whose station is off the path carries nothing, which is how a vehicle
drives on at one end and off at the other.

PathPrim.description:
A bar route through control points, rather than a single straight run.

Two shapes, and the choice between them is not a smoothing preference:

`polyline` (the default) lays a straight leg between each pair of points.
It is exact -- the bar goes where the points say and nowhere else -- and it
is what a bent-up bar, an L-bar, a hook and a HARPED pretensioned tendon
actually are. Each leg is subdivided by `segment_length` (or `divisions`)
the way an ordinary `line` is.

`parabola` takes exactly three points and draws the unique quadratic
through them, with the middle point at the PARAMETER midpoint -- so for the
usual symmetric tendon (anchorage, low point at midspan, anchorage) the
middle point is the low point, and for an asymmetric profile it is not what
you meant and `polyline` is the honest way to say it. The curve is sampled
at EQUAL ARC LENGTH, so `segment_length` means the same physical thing here
as it does on a straight bar (see BarLineSpec: it is a smearing length, not
a discretisation choice), and each chord becomes one bar segment.

A path can `repeat`, exactly as a line can: several parallel tendons or a
row of identical bent-up bars is one entry plus an offset.

WHAT A CURVED TENDON DOES NOT BUY YOU. The geometry is right and the
prestress acts along it -- so the vertical component of a draped tendon
balances load, which is the whole point of draping one. Friction is still
not computed: `prestress` remains the effective stress after losses. What
preflight can now give you is the number a friction calculation needs, the
tendon's total angular change, because a path has one.

截面种类，决定承载它的单元：solid 实体、shell 壳、beam 梁（beam2）、fiber 纤维梁（beam2_fiber）、bar 杆/索（truss2）、connector 连接器（connector2）

what the section is, and so which element carries it: solid (the meshed continuum), shell, beam (beam2), fiber (beam2_fiber), bar (truss2: bars, cables), connector (connector2)

a name in `materials`; optional for a connector; required on a fiber section (the law of every patch that names none of its own)

solid, `reduced` only: hourglass stabilisation coefficient

形状：圆 `circle`、矩形 `rect`、工字 `I`、直接给性质 `general`；纤维截面另有圆管 `tube`、箱 `box`、四边形块 `patches`

cantilever_thickness.title: Cantilever Thickness
cantilever_thickness.description:

the cantilever (flange outstand): one value or [at the web, at the tip]; default top_thickness

iy.description:

second moment about the section y axis (fibres vary in z), m^4

绕 z 轴的惯性矩，m⁴

second moment about z, m^4

Timoshenko shear correction factor on az

nr.title: Nr
nr.description:

fibres through the wall thickness of a tube or box

cover.description:

core_material.description:
纤维 rect：`cover` 以内箍筋约束核心的材料（`materials` 里的名字）

integration.description:
纤维：沿构件的积分站——gauss2（默认）或 lobatto3/4/5（含端点，铰在端部形成时用）

fiber: stations along the member -- gauss2 (default) or lobatto3/4/5 (end points sampled; a hinge forms at the end)

patches.title: Patches
patches.description:
`shape: patches`：由四边形块拼成的纤维截面 [{corners: 四个 [y, z], ny, nz, material?, holes?}]，可有斜腹板、承托、孔洞

`shape: patches`: a fibre section built of quadrilateral patches [{corners: [[y, z] x 4], ny, nz}], each subdivided bilinearly -- a box girder with inclined webs, haunches and tapered cantilevers. Coordinates in the section axes, as `bars`.

shear_stiffness.title: Shear Stiffness
shear_stiffness.description:
纤维截面的有效剪切刚度 κGA_s（N）：给了即按 Timoshenko 插值并加常剪应变；纤维不参与剪切，是分析者给定的弹性（或开裂折减）剪切柔度

Effective shear stiffness kappa G A_s [N] of the fibre section. Absent, the member is Euler-Bernoulli; given, the bending interpolation becomes Timoshenko's (Reddy's interdependent element, phi = 12 E I / (GA_s L^2) per member) and a constant shear strain gamma = V / GA_s is added. The fibres do not see shear: this is the elastic (or cracked-effective, e.g. ASCE 41's 0.4 E_c A_w) member shear flexibility, stated by the analyst.

shear.description:
纤维截面的开裂剪切律：未开裂 κGA → 开裂（弯曲开裂触发）后按给定或箍筋桁架模型的刚度 → 可选箍筋屈服；与 `shear_stiffness` 二选一；1.7 起也进了 numba 内核

a cracking shear law for a fibre section, in series with the bending; exclusive with `shear_stiffness`; in the numba kernel since 1.7

bars.title: Bars
bars.description:
截面内的钢筋 [{y, z, section: 杆截面名, count?}]，`count` 把 n 根相同钢筋合在一点

[{y, z, section: <bar section name>, count?}] -- OpenSees `layer` per bar; `count` lumps n identical bars at the point

bar_layers.title: Bar Layers
bar_layers.description:
纤维截面内成排的钢筋（1.2）：[{section, from: [y, z], to: [y, z], count 或 spacing, z_from: origin|top|bottom}]，两端都放，按间距时取不大于它的等间距

bars laid in straight layers (1.2): [{section, from: [y, z], to: [y, z], count | spacing, z_from}] -- both ends included; `spacing` puts as many bars as fit at that spacing or closer (d16 @ 150 over 1 m is 8 bars); `z_from: top | bottom` measures z from that face, downward from the top

tendons.title: Tendons
tendons.description:
纤维截面内的预应力束：{section, profile: [[s, y, z], ...], prestress 或 jack + friction, elastic_shortening: none|compensate}；束按各单元中点处的 profile 位置成为一根带初应变的粘结钢纤维

PRESTRESSING TENDONS of a fibre section: each is {section: <bar section>, profile: [[s, y, z], ...], interpolation: linear | quadratic, normalised: false, prestress: <Pa> | [[s, <Pa>], ...]  |  jack: <Pa>, friction: {mu, k, jack, anchor_set}, elastic_shortening: none | compensate} `profile` is the tendon's line: `s` the distance along the member from its start (the end with the smaller global x, then y, then z; a fraction of the member length when `normalised`), `y`/`z` the offsets in the section axes, as for `bars`; `quadratic` is one parabola through each three consecutive points (0-1-2, 2-3-4, ...: an odd count), and the curve as placed must stay inside the section. The tendon becomes a bonded steel fibre whose position is the profile's value at each element's midpoint -- a draped tendon is a polyline of one eccentricity per element -- carrying an initial strain: `prestress` is the stress the tendon holds with the section unstrained, or `jack` is the stress at the jack and `friction` is the post-tensioning loss profile the embedded tendons already use. What the relaxation then finds is the elastic shortening; `elastic_shortening: compensate` adds the linear-elastic estimate of it back (the gross section's 3x3 stiffness about the origin, so a T or a box need not be written about its centroid), so the stated stress is what the tendon carries against the hardened, already-shortened concrete.

fracture.title: Fracture
fracture.description:
`{threshold: 1.0}`：截面内失效纤维达到这个比例时构件断开（写在截面上，因为截面才知道有多少纤维）

`fracture: {threshold: 1.0}` -- the member is severed when that fraction of its fibres has failed. On the SECTION and not on the assignment because it is the section that says how many fibres there are and which laws they carry; what makes a fibre fail is in the material block.

stiffness.title: Stiffness
stiffness.description:
连接器：六个对角刚度 [ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz]（N/m、N·m/rad）或对称 6×6 矩阵（docs/connector2.md）

connector: six diagonal values [ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz] (N/m, N m/rad) or a symmetric 6x6 matrix (docs/connector2.md)

connector_damping.title: Connector Damping
connector_damping.description:

connector: viscous damping in the same form as `stiffness` (N s/m, N m s/rad)

curves.title: Curves
curves.description:
连接器：某分量的分段线性力–位移骨架 [[u, F], ...]，代替该分量的刚度（可逆、单调不减）

connector: per component a piecewise-linear force-displacement skeleton [[u, F], ...] replacing that component's stiffness (reversible, non-decreasing)

laws.title: Laws
laws.description:
连接器：某分量的路径相关律——`gap` 间隙/限位、`bilinear` 双线性滞回（隔震支座）、`friction` 库仑摩擦滑动；见 ConnectorLawSpec

connector: a path-dependent law per component -- gap, bilinear hysteresis, Coulomb friction (schema.ConnectorLawSpec)

SoilSpringSpec.description:
Soil springs on a pile: p-y curves by depth, nonlinear elastic (1.2).
Each node of the region below the ground gets a horizontal spring of the
curve at its depth times the pile length it stands for.

region.title: Region
region.description:
桩的构件区域（两端都在区域内的构件）

the pile's members (both ends in the region)

ground.title: Ground
ground.description:
地面高程：沿 `vertical` 的坐标，其下的桩段受土弹簧

the ground surface, as a coordinate on `vertical`: the pile below it carries springs

direction.title: Direction
direction.description:
`horizontal`：水平面内径向（按两个水平位移的合量取抗力）；`x`、`y`（或 `z`）：只沿一个轴，平面模型用

`horizontal`: radial in the horizontal plane (the resistance follows the resultant of the two horizontal displacements); `x`, `y` (or `z`): one axis only, for a plane model

curves.title: Curves
curves.description:
各深度的 p–y 曲线；深度之间按同一 y 线性插值，浅于第一条取第一条，深于最后一条取最后一条

the p-y curves by depth: between two depths interpolated at the same y; above the first the first, below the last the last

SoilSpringSpec.title: SoilSpringSpec

mode.title: Mode
mode.description:
`relaxation` 动力松弛求静力解，`static` 隐式静力（Newton），或 `dynamic` 显式时程

`relaxation` (dynamic relaxation to a static state), `static` (implicit, Newton) or `dynamic` (explicit time history)

static.description:
隐式静力的设置（见 StaticSpec）

the implicit static solver's settings (see StaticSpec)

mass.description:
松弛：`underwood`（参考刚度的 Gershgorin 行和，默认）或 `eigenvalue`（各单元最大特征值，大转动下仍成立）；动力：`physical`

damping.description:
见 DampingSpec；松弛默认 kinetic，动力默认无阻尼

see DampingSpec; kinetic by default under relaxation, none under dynamic

total_time.title: Total Time
total_time.description:
动力：模拟时长（s），必填

dynamic: simulated duration (s); required

dt_safety.title: Dt Safety
dt_safety.description:
实际步长占稳定步长的比例

fraction of the stable explicit step actually used

target_dt.description:
动力、连续体：均匀放大质量把步长抬到这个值（选择性的见 `mass_scaling`）

dynamic, continuum: raise the step to this by uniformly scaling the mass (see `mass_scaling` for the selective form)

n_steps.title: N Steps
n_steps.description:
松弛：迭代预算；每个分析步都自带预算时可省

relaxation: iteration budget; may be left out when every step carries its own

tolerance.description:

kinetic_tolerance.description:

relaxation: fraction of the stable step, as `dt_safety` for dynamic

erosion.description:
单元删除；不写即不删

omit entirely to disable element deletion

load_steps.title: Load Steps
load_steps.description:
分级：每一级保持到平衡，每个输出帧都是荷载–位移曲线上的真实点

hold each load level until equilibrium; every output frame is then a genuine point on the load-displacement curve

max_steps_per_load.title: Max Steps Per Load
max_steps_per_load.description:
带 `load_steps` 的松弛：每级迭代预算

relaxation with `load_steps`: iteration budget per level

stage_ramp_iterations.title: Stage Ramp Iterations
stage_ramp_iterations.description:
每级荷载渐入所用的迭代数（默认 max_steps_per_load/5）

iterations over which each load level is blended in (default max_steps_per_load / 5)

age.title: Age

开始时的混凝土龄期（天）；只有材料声明了 creep/shrinkage/ageing 才读

mass_scaling.description:
选择性质量缩放：只在 beam2、beam2_timoshenko、beam2_fiber、mixed_line 上；其他拒绝

initial_state.title: Initial State
initial_state.description:
从本模型早先一次结果的终态起步——位置、转角、材料状态，静止、t = 0。典型用法：先松弛得恒载状态，再从它做动力。相对算例文件；结果的网格必须是本算例的网格

The typical pair: a relaxation run for the dead state, then a dynamic run from it. Relative to the case file; the result's mesh must be this case's mesh.

'numpy' (reference) or 'numba' (fused scalar kernel, same answer)

One design spectrum and the direction it acts in.

stabilise.description:
稳定化 Newton（1.23，伪时间延拓）：一个增量的 Newton 不收敛时，先从增量起点再算一次，每个自由度挂一根弹簧（μ 乘切线对角）拉回本轮的起点；每轮收敛后弹簧锚点移到新位置、μ 除以 4，直到不计弹簧的残差也在容差内——最终是真正的平衡，弹簧只是到达它的路。针对切线准确但病态的模型，例如桥面端部几乎不能抗扭的悬索桥。然后才减半。只用于荷载控制的增量（弧长法不用）。默认关闭：它会越过极限点（荷载控制下的跳跃），那是静力分析应当报出来的；Midas 转换器给它写出的桥梁打开

For a tangent that is right and ill-conditioned (a suspension bridge's deck whose end bays barely resist twisting); before the increment is halved; load-controlled increments only (not arc length). Off by default: it crosses limit points (a snap-through under load control, which a static analysis must report, not take); the Midas converter turns it on for the bridges it writes

TemperatureSpec.description:
A temperature change over a member's section.

Temperature is not a force. It is a FREE STRAIN the section would take on
if nothing held it: eps_th(y, z) = alpha * T(y, z). What that produces
depends entirely on what is in the way --

  * nothing in the way (a determinate member, a linear T): the member
    simply changes shape. It elongates by alpha dT L, it bows to a
    curvature alpha dT/dy, and it carries NO stress at all.
  * something in the way (a restrained end, a redundant support): the part
    of the free strain the structure refuses becomes force -- an axial
    N = EA alpha dT, a continuous beam's secondary moments.
  * a NONLINEAR T through the depth (which is what a bridge code's design
    profile is): even a simply supported beam cannot take that shape,
    because plane sections must stay plane. The section keeps the linear
    part as elongation and curvature and turns the rest into
    self-equilibrated stresses -- zero net force, zero net moment, and
    real stress. Only a fibre section can show them: a `profile` on a
    `beam2` / `beam2_timoshenko` section (shaped or `general`) is refused,
    not reduced -- reducing it needs the area distribution a beam section
    does not carry.

The field is `uniform` + `gradient`, or a `profile` sampled through the
section. `gradient` is K per metre of section depth rather than "top minus
bottom", because a `general` beam section states area and second moments
and has no depth to divide by.

A `rect`/`box` has its depth on z (width along y); a `patches` section on whichever axis its corners put it -- so a deck's vertical profile names the axis rather than assuming one. Refused with a two-component gradient, which names its axes already.

FractureSpec.description:
When an element stops carrying load, and what happens then.

ONE NUMBER, because everything else about fracture is decided elsewhere on
purpose (core/fracture.py): WHEN a material point is finished is the
material's business and is written in the material block (a bar's
`rupture_strain`, a damage law's own limit), and HOW the points of this
element family add up is the element's and is not a choice at all. What is
left for the analyst is how much of the section has to be gone before the
member is treated as severed, and the honest default is all of it.

separate the member from the frame when it fractures, instead of only switching its forces off. The member's share of the mass moves onto particles of its own and the fragment falls. Off by default because it is a different analysis: it needs solver.mode = dynamic, it reserves two particles per element, and what the debris then lands on is not modelled yet -- there is no contact.

BondSpec.description:
Bond stress-slip between an embedded bar and its host.

Present means the bar gets its OWN degrees of freedom and may slip; absent
means perfect bond, which is cheaper, runs on every backend, and is right
whenever the member is not expected to crack. See materials/bond.py for the
law and v0.1 for why the choice matters more than it looks.

TWO LAWS SHIP, AND THE DEFAULT IS THE MONOTONIC ONE
    `bond_ceb`     the MC2010 envelope with a linear unloading rule. Right
                   for a pushover; under a long cyclic history it
                   overstates the bond that survives, which is the unsafe
                   direction.
    `bond_cyclic`  the same envelope with Eligehausen-type degradation and
                   a pinched reversal. Identical to `bond_ceb` on a
                   monotonic path, bit for bit, so switching costs nothing
                   but the extra state.

    The default stays `bond_ceb` because changing it would silently
    re-rate every model that already names a bond block.

FailureSpec.description:
When a line member breaks: ELASTIC-BRITTLE -- linear
until the criterion, then gone. Dynamic runs only; per member group in a
mixed_line model (`assign[].failure`), for every member of a single-
section beam2/beam2_timoshenko/truss2 model (`element.failure`).

A bar (cable) breaks when its tension reaches `tensile_strength` x area.
A beam breaks when, at either end, |N|/(A f_y) + |M_y|/M_y,cap +
|M_z|/M_z,cap >= 1 with M_cap = shape_factor f_y I / c: `extreme_fibre`
is [c_y, c_z], the distances from the member axis to the extreme fibres
along the section's local y and z. Shear and torsion are not checked
against a strength; but a beam twisted a quarter turn end to end is
removed (the co-rotational frame cannot follow half a turn), and a
piece broken at both ends is removed once its demand reaches twice its
capacity (it is still steel).

Why not a strain limit: in an elastic member the strain at which steel
actually tears (15%) is reached only at 30 000 MPa, so the member would
never break first; a CAPACITY is what an elastic member can be checked
against, and it needs only A, I and the depth of the section.

tensile_strength.title: Tensile Strength
tensile_strength.description:

yield_strength.title: Yield Strength
yield_strength.description:
梁：承载力判据 |N|/N_p + |M_y|/M_y,cap + |M_z|/M_z,cap ≥ 1 用的屈服强度（Pa）

beams: the yield strength (Pa) behind N_p = f_y A and M_cap = shape_factor f_y I / c

extreme_fibre.title: Extreme Fibre
extreme_fibre.description:
[c_y, c_z]：构件轴到局部 y、z 方向最外纤维的距离（m），M_cap = 形状系数·f_y·I/c

beams: [c_y, c_z], the distances (m) from the member axis to the extreme fibres along the section's local y and z

shape_factor.title: Shape Factor
shape_factor.description:
塑性/弹性弯矩之比（1 = 首次屈服；箱形约 1.12）

plastic over elastic moment (1 = first yield; a thin-walled box about 1.12)

rotation_capacity.title: Rotation Capacity
rotation_capacity.description:
梁（mixed_line）：给了它，梁端就是塑性铰——端弯矩按 |N|/N_p + |M_y|/M_y,p + |M_z|/M_z,p ≤ 1 封顶，超出的转成塑性转角，累计塑性转角（rad）到它才在该端断开；不写就是弹脆性，到承载力立即断开

beams (mixed_line): given, every end is a PLASTIC HINGE -- the end moments are capped on |N|/N_p + |M_y|/M_y,p + |M_z|/M_z,p <= 1, what would exceed it becomes plastic rotation, and the end breaks when its accumulated plastic rotation (rad) reaches this; left out, elastic-brittle: the end breaks the moment the capacity is reached

split.title: Split
split.description:
断了之后：true 质点分裂——构件两端移到自己的备用质点上、带着质量脱开、继续作为一段自由的弹性构件；false 只是不再传力、质量留在节点。不写：梁/mixed_line 分裂，独立桁架不分裂

after the break: true splits the member off onto its own particles with its mass (a free elastic segment), false only deactivates it (mass stays on the nodes); left out, frames and mixed_line split, the standalone truss deactivates
